title: UNFCCC Greenhouse Gas Data Interface — FAQ
text: The UNFCCC greenhouse gas data interface offers access to emissions inventories reported by countries, with tabular views and some exports including CSV. Official reporting metadata and accounting conventions must be reviewed.

title: UNFCCC Transparency and Reporting
text: Climate transparency reporting supports evidence-based review of national emissions, climate actions and progress. Biennial transparency reports and national inventories are relevant evidence sources.

title: IPCC 2006 Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories
text: IPCC inventory guidance describes greenhouse gas accounting methods, sector definitions, activity data, emission factors and uncertainty assessment.
